svg.title: Sun & Moon Sacred Geometry — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A balanced celestial face surrounded by twenty-four geometric color rays. Full-color library preview; open the SVG to use the numbered mandala-style worksheet. Click a region to apply its suggested color. Shift-click to clear it.
